prior_year_events.impact_description: Strengthening the Casualty UK account following an in depth assessment of the reserves by the PMA actuarial function (cumulative GAAP loss of GBP 4.64m in respect of 2018 & prior).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 5.614m gross (about 3.4% of opening gross claims outstanding). The movement reflects mixed development across older underwriting years with a notable reserve strengthening in the Casualty UK account following an in-depth actuarial reassessment (the report cites a cumulative GAAP loss of GBP 4.64m in respect of 2018 & prior years). The calculation above is derived from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: movements in 2021 principally as a result of strengthening the Casualty UK account following an in depth assessment of the reserves by the PMA actuarial function.
A cumulative GAAP loss of GBP (4,640,000) in respect of 2018 & prior years of accounts
An adjustment for distribution purposes of GBP (743,000) in respect of the reversal of the impact on the prior year unearned premium and pipeline premium assessed at this year-end.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (5.614m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 74 by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years up to 2019 (triangle values are presented in GBP 000). No explicit standalone 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was found; the managing agent narrative does state a cumulative GAAP loss of GBP 4.64m for 2018 & prior (strengthening of Casualty UK) which was used to identify the principal cause. RITC / Part VII activity (noted in the report) may affect comparability but the report states the combined Part VII/Quota-Share had no economic impact. All monetary amounts converted to millions (from GBP 000) for reporting.
